description:
JMD Art Gallery is a leading Art & Decor Solutions company based in Mumbai, serving clients across India for over 23 years. Transform walls into conversation pieces.

From premium art prints and custom framing to designer mirrors, sculptures, murals, and bespoke décor, JMD Art Gallery offers curated solutions for homes, offices, hotels, and commercial spaces. Discover timeless designs, expert craftsmanship, and distinctive pieces that bring beauty, personality, and purpose to every corner of your space.

New Collection Release at JMD Art Gallery, Mumbai 

Experience the beauty of nature through the expressive brushstrokes of renowned artist Rahul Rai. Presenting "Landscapes of Nature"—an exclusive collection of original landscape paintings that capture serenity, emotion, and the timeless essence of the natural world.

Each artwork is a one-of-a-kind original painting, accompanied by a Certificate of Authenticity, making it a perfect addition to luxury homes, offices, hotels, and thoughtfully designed interior spaces.

Whether you're an art collector, interior designer, or simply looking to elevate your space, this collection offers timeless pieces that inspire and create lasting impressions.

 Visit JMD Art Gallery in Mumbai and explore a collection that brings the beauty of nature into your everyday surroundings.

Every remarkable space has a focal point. What will yours be?

A blank wall is an opportunity waiting to be transformed.

From luxury residences and corporate offices to hotels, restaurants, and commercial spaces, we curate art that adds character, elevates aesthetics, and creates unforgettable experiences. Our bespoke art solutions are designed to turn ordinary interiors into spaces that inspire, engage, and leave a lasting impression.

 If you're planning a project, let's create a space people will remember.

 Get in touch to explore the perfect art solution for your space.

Inauguration highlights from the ongoing exhibition at JMD Art Gallery.

The exhibition was inaugurated on 16 January 2026 and will remain open until 31 January 2026.
We invite art lovers and visitors to experience the artworks at the gallery.

So great for people doing restaurants, concept stores,Bungalow or even NRIs but if you are a regular at buying antiques you will  know the difference

featured_reviews.name: Ayushi Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: This place has nicely kept and preserved some of the most unique vintage stuff. Most people would love to just stroll around here. It has a collection of old frames, old commercial prints, vintage decór, beautiful old mirrors, God-idols, lamps, door brackets, and belongings of people in the 40s, 50s, or so. I thoroughly enjoyed myself, though couldn't buy anything because I was short of budget.

featured_reviews.name: Marie Truchassou
featured_reviews.review_text: I know Manish for more than 10 years and his shop is an Ali Baba cave, I am always able to find gifts and nice antics to bring back home. Thank you Manish !

featured_reviews.name: simran tapadia
featured_reviews.review_text: Was excited for visit this place, but over hyped obviously!! Extremely over priced. 3000 for a b5 frame 😭 had a good laugh at the rates and walked ahead and found better stores.

featured_reviews.name: sushma kotra
featured_reviews.review_text: The owner of the shop attended us very well. They have a great collection of antique pieces that are genuine and date back to many tens and hundreds of years. A wide variety that included furniture, frames, mirrors, idols, statues, figurines, posters, boxes, hangings, decor, and much more in good quality material.

featured_reviews.name: Viveck Yaadav
featured_reviews.review_text: The inventory is undeniably antique, but the items are severely overpriced. Many products are old, rusty, and appear to be collected as scrap, yet they are sold at premium rates. I recommend not to go here..

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Theeda
featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful Store with food collection.Mankish is very passionate about Antiques and had lot of knowledge. The price is reasonable and more important the shopping and experience was great. I have been to this place twice already.
